title: Identity and composition of actual integral reduction transitions
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, let l be a prime different from its characteristic, let E be a finite extension of Q_l, and let W be a scheme. Use the completed coefficient category and actual scalar-reduction functors of [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. For every object M of this derived category, write L_n M for its derived reduction at exponent n+1, and t_(m,n)(M): L_m M -> Res_(m,n)(L_n M) for the transition fixed by the smaller quotient unit under the scalar adjunction [def-pur-integral-reduction-transitions]. With the canonical restriction unit and compositor of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], the following equations hold: t_(n,n)(M);unit_n = id, and t_(c,b)(M);Res_(c,b)(t_(b,a)(M));comp_(c,b,a) = t_(c,a)(M) for every a <= b <= c. No constructibility, boundedness or completeness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Transpose both equations under the scalar extension/restriction adjunction at the largest index. By definition each transition transposes to the smaller quotient unit followed by the inverse restriction compositor. Naturality of the intermediate unit and the adjunction triangle identities remove the intermediate transition.

proof.text: Use the canonical restriction identity and composition equations. After naturality moves the intermediate transition past the inverse completion comparison, its defining adjunction equation removes it. The restriction coherence equation identifies the remaining composite with the direct transition transpose. Injectivity of the Hom bijection gives the claimed equations.

theorem integralReductionTransition_cocycles
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (W : Scheme.{u}) (M : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E W D hl) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, normalizedDVRReductionTransition.{u, u, u} l E W D hl (Nat.le_refl n) M ≫
      (normalizedDVRResUnit.{u, u} l E W n).hom.app _ = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (∀ {c b a : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c),
      normalizedDVRReductionTransition.{u, u, u} l E W D hl hbc M ≫
        (normalizedDVRRes.{u, u} l E W hbc).map
          (normalizedDVRReductionTransition.{u, u, u} l E W D hl hab M) ≫
        (normalizedDVRResComp.{u, u} l E W hbc hab).hom.app _ =
      normalizedDVRReductionTransition.{u, u, u} l E W D hl (hab.trans hbc) M)
